name: All for Jesus, or the Easy Ways of Divine Love
name_pt: Tudo por Jesus, ou os Caminhos Fáceis do Amor Divino
author: Fr. Frederick William Faber
desc: Faber's first great devotional treatise (1853), written for the Confraternity of the Precious Blood: nine chapters on loving Jesus by taking up His interests, sympathizing with Him in His sorrows, offering Him reparation, and winning souls, with a closing chapter on devotion to the souls in purgatory and a letter to the Confraternity.
desc_pt: O primeiro grande tratado devocional de Faber (1853), escrito para a Confraria do Preciosíssimo Sangue: nove capítulos sobre o amor a Jesus — tomar a peito os Seus interesses, compadecer-se das Suas dores, oferecer-Lhe reparação e ganhar almas —, com um capítulo final sobre a devoção às almas do purgatório e uma carta à Confraria.
editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (London: Richardson and Son, 1853)
edition: All for Jesus, or the Easy Ways of Divine Love (London and Derby: Richardson and Son, 1853), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The prefaces to the first four editions are given as one preface; the analytic table of contents and the index are dropped.
